# `@jrm/tokens` (vendored)

These files are **vendored verbatim** from
[`jrmoulckers/studio`](https://github.com/jrmoulckers/studio) at commit
`a26d52650a6c54bb5de16d9533c37b2a4680d881`, path `packages/tokens/dist/`.

**Do not edit anything under this directory by hand.** The tokens are generated by Style
Dictionary in the upstream `studio` repo and are provenance-stamped. Hand-editing trips the
studio sync engine's drift detection, after which the file is skipped on every subsequent
sync. To change a token value, change it upstream in `jrmoulckers/studio` and re-sync.

This tree normally arrives automatically via a `chore(sync)` PR opened by the studio sync
engine. That engine has not yet run for `libro`, so this **first** copy was vendored by hand —
which _is_ the first manual sync. Provenance is recorded in `.studio-sync.lock.json` at the
repo root.

## Consumption

There is no registry for `@jrm/tokens`, so it is **not** an app dependency. It is consumed by
relative import from `src/app.css`:

```css
@import '../vendor/@jrm/tokens/css/default/index.css';
```

## Contents

- `css/default/index.css` — entry point; imports the base + theme layers and wires the
  `prefers-color-scheme` / `prefers-contrast` / `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks.
- `css/default/tokens.css` — the light base (`:root`) plus every primitive, semantic, and
  component custom property, including the back-compat `--color-*` aliases.
- `css/default/tokens-dark.css` — `[data-theme="dark"]` semantic overrides.
- `css/default/tokens-dark-oled.css` — `[data-theme="dark-oled"]` semantic overrides.
- `css/default/tokens-high-contrast.css` — `[data-theme="high-contrast"]` semantic overrides.
- `package.json` — upstream package manifest (metadata only; not installed).
